# HexPiece 3.9.0

Gryphon's and the Iron Mace's last borrowed cuts made their own. **Not tested in game yet:** the build and all 15 test suites pass;
all 63 sword animations passed the body check (no arm through the body, nothing through the head, every half tick) and were rendered.

## Saber (Gryphon)
- **Its own kesa and makko:** until now Gryphon swung the katanas' versions of these two, because with its bigger handle and bell
  guard the katanas' wind-ups put its arm through the body (kesa) and its handle through the brow (makko). Both now have their own
  wind-up, the fist further out and forward, and swing with the Saber's extra aggression like its other 12 cuts.

## Mace
- **Its own gyaku yoko (the backhand):** the mace is cocked low and out before the backhand, so its big spiked head clears your head,
  then swung across hard like its other cuts. 15 of its 16 cuts are now its own; the plunge is still the katanas' for the mace (its
  arm flips between two beats with the mace's grip; to be written next).
